about-us.title: About Us
about-us.body:
Dress Like Mommy was born from a simple idea: families that match together, bond together.

Our story

Dress Like Mommy grew from Francisco's family idea in Naples, Florida: the joy his daughters felt when they matched outfits with their mom. That spark became the heart of a business that has been helping families match since 2016: the giggles, the photos, the "we're twinning!" moments.

What we do

We curate matching outfits for moms, dads, kids and babies: cozy holiday pajamas, everyday sets, swimwear and special-occasion looks. Every style is chosen for comfort, style and value, so families can create picture-perfect moments without breaking the bank.

  • Since 2016family-owned and online-only
  • Whole familymatching looks for mom, dad, kids and baby
  • Real supporta real person usually answers within 1 business day

How we keep prices family-friendly

We're an online-only store, with no showroom or retail rent. We partner with trusted manufacturing and fulfillment partners who produce our styles and ship them directly to you. Because many of them are overseas, delivery takes a little longer than from a local store, so we always recommend ordering early for holidays and special dates.

Why families shop with us

  • Matching made easy: coordinated outfits for photos, holidays, trips and everyday moments
  • Shipping included: standard shipping is built into our prices where a standard method is available
  • Clear 30-day returns: simple steps in our Returns & exchanges policy
  • Secure checkout: payments are processed by Shopify; we never see your full card number
  • Help with sizing: send us your measurements and we'll suggest sizes before you order

Share your matching moments

We love seeing families match. Tag us with #DressLikeMommy on Facebook or Instagram. We'd love to reshare your photos. We always ask your permission first and credit you.

Questions? We're here to help.

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, Naples, Florida.

Contact us Shop matching outfits

shipping-info.title: Shipping Info
shipping-info.body:
Dress Like Mommy is an online-only store. Our matching outfits are made and shipped by trusted manufacturing and fulfillment partners, most of them overseas, straight to your door. That keeps prices family-friendly. It also means delivery takes longer than from a local store, so please plan ahead for holidays and photo days.

  • Includedstandard shipping is built into our prices where a standard method is available
  • 1–3 business daysto prepare your order before it ships
  • Trackedtracking is emailed as soon as the carrier provides it

Delivery times

Checkout shows the shipping method for your address before you pay. If checkout shows a delivery estimate, it is an estimate, not a guaranteed date. Customs, weather, holidays, carrier volume and local conditions can add time, especially from November through January.

Ordering for a date? For Christmas mornings, birthdays, weddings or photo sessions, order early and allow extra time. If you need an order by a specific date, email us before ordering and we'll tell you honestly whether it is realistic.

How your order travels

  1. Order confirmed: you receive a confirmation email.
  2. Processing (1–3 business days): your items are checked and packed. Busy seasons can add 1–2 business days.
  3. Shipped: we email your tracking number. Tracking can take 24–48 hours, sometimes longer on international routes, to show the first scan.
  4. In transit: follow your parcel on our Track your order page.
  5. Delivered: to the address you entered at checkout.

Orders with several items may arrive in more than one parcel, on different days. Tracking is emailed for each parcel when available.

Where we ship

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can deliver there. If your country isn't listed, email info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering. P.O. Box, APO/FPO and freight-forwarder addresses depend on carrier options and may not be supported.

Customs, duties and import taxes

Unless checkout shows that duties and taxes are included, import duties, taxes, brokerage or customs fees charged by your country are paid by the customer. We can't predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or declare a lower value, because false declarations are illegal. If a parcel is refused, or never collected because of these charges, we can refund the items after the parcel returns to us, less the return shipping cost we were charged, which we will tell you, except where the law requires a full refund.

Please double-check your address

We ship to the address entered at checkout. Email us within 24 hours if it needs to change; once an order has shipped, we can't redirect it. If a parcel is returned or lost because of an incorrect or incomplete address, we'll help, but reshipping costs are the customer's responsibility.

Late, lost or "delivered" but not received

  • Tracking not moving? International parcels often go days without an update while clearing customs. If tracking shows no movement for 15 business days, or your order hasn't arrived within 30 days after it shipped, email us your order number. We'll open an investigation with the carrier and, if the parcel is confirmed lost, reship or refund it.
  • Marked delivered but not there? Check around your property, with neighbors and building reception, and wait 48 hours, because carriers sometimes scan early. Then contact us within 14 days of the delivery scan and we'll file a claim with the carrier and help you get it resolved.
  • Arrived damaged? Take photos of the parcel and the item and email us within 7 days of delivery. See our Returns & exchanges page.

Our promise

If we can't ship your order within the time we've stated, we'll email you. You can then wait for it or cancel for a full refund of the items not shipped.

Questions about shipping?

Include your order number and we'll usually reply within 1 business day.

Email us Track your order

return-policy.title: Returns & Exchanges
return-policy.body:
We want your whole family to love their matching outfits. If something isn't right, here is exactly how returns, exchanges and refunds work, so there are no surprises.

  • 30 daysfrom delivery to request a return
  • 7 daysto report a damaged, defective or wrong item
  • 5–10 business daysto refund after your return is approved

Start with a quick email

  1. Email info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number, the item(s), and the reason. Photos help us solve things faster.
  2. We usually reply within 1 business day with your options and, if a return is needed, a return authorization and the correct return address.
  3. Pack the item(s) unworn, with tags, and ship them with a tracked service. Send us the tracking number.
  4. After the return arrives and passes inspection, we refund your original payment method.

Please wait for your return authorization before shipping anything. We are an online-only store: our business mailing address is not a returns center. Parcels sent without authorization, or to the wrong address, may be lost or delayed and may not be eligible for a refund.

What can be returned

Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery when they are:

  • Unworn, unwashed and in original condition
  • Returned with all original tags attached and in their original packaging
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, deodorant or other signs of use

Not returnable

  • Swimwear and intimates once the hygiene liner or seal has been removed or worn
  • Items marked "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items requested for return more than 30 days after delivery

These exclusions do not apply to items that are damaged, defective or not as described.

Damaged, defective or wrong item

If something arrives damaged, defective, or different from what you ordered, email us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item, the label or size tag, and the packaging. Once we confirm the issue we will send a replacement or issue a refund for the affected item. In most of these cases you do not need to send anything back. Reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights.

Exchanges

Need a different size or color? Email us with your order number. We can usually send the new size as a new order, and refund the original item once your return is approved. That way your family's outfits arrive together as soon as possible.

Return shipping costs

  • If we made a mistake, or the item is damaged or defective, we cover the cost.
  • For all other returns (for example, change of mind or a different size), return shipping is paid by the customer. We recommend a tracked service: we can't refund parcels that are lost on their way back to us without tracking.
  • Because our products ship from our fulfillment partners, return postage can sometimes cost more than the item itself. When that happens, we may offer you a partial refund or store credit and let you keep the item instead. The choice is always yours.

Refunds

  • Refunds go to your original payment method within 5–10 business days after approval. Your bank may need another 2–5 business days to show it.
  • Standard shipping is included in our prices, so there is no separate shipping charge to refund. Paid express upgrades are refunded only when we made an error or where the law requires it.
  • Items returned used, washed, damaged, or without tags may be refused, sent back to you, or receive a partial refund, where the law allows.
  • Still waiting after 10 business days? Check with your bank or card issuer first, then email us and we'll investigate.

Cancellations

Email us as soon as possible, ideally within 24 hours of ordering. If your order hasn't entered fulfillment, we'll cancel it and refund you in full. Once an order has entered fulfillment it can't be cancelled; you can return it after delivery under this policy.

Please talk to us before opening a dispute

Almost every problem can be fixed faster by email than through a bank or PayPal dispute, which can take weeks. If you open a dispute or chargeback, we will share your order details, tracking and our messages with the payment provider so it can review the case.

Your legal rights

This policy does not limit any rights you have under the consumer laws of your country. For example, customers in the EU and UK have a right to cancel online purchases within 14 days of delivery. Where local law gives you more protection, the law applies.

Need help with a return?

Include your order number and we'll usually reply within 1 business day.

Email info@dresslikemommy.com

Last updated: September 27, 2026. This page summarizes our Refund Policy.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.body:
Quick answers to the questions families ask us most. Can't find yours? Contact us: a real person usually replies within 1 business day.

About Dress Like Mommy

Is it safe to shop on this site?

Yes. Checkout is hosted securely by Shopify and supports the payment methods shown at checkout. We never see or store your full card number.

Where are you based?

Dress Like Mommy is an online-only store operated by FKG Trading LLC in Naples, Florida, USA. We don't have a physical store or showroom. Our styles are made and shipped by trusted manufacturing and fulfillment partners, many of them overseas, directly to you.

How can your prices be so reasonable?

We sell online only, with no store rent, and ship directly from our production and fulfillment partners. We pass the savings on to families.

How quickly do you answer emails?

Usually within 1 business day, Monday to Friday. Include your order number so we can help in one reply.

Before you order

How do I choose the right size?

Use the size chart on each product page. Sizes vary by style and many run smaller than typical US sizes, so compare measurements in cm or inches, not your usual letter size. Our Size guide shows how to measure, or email us your measurements for a recommendation.

How do I order matching outfits for the whole family?

Open the style you love, choose each person's size (for example, one for mom and one for each child), and add them to your cart one by one. You'll find matching pieces for dad, kids and baby linked from the product page where available.

What payment methods do you accept?

All the options shown at checkout, including major cards and available wallets such as Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal where supported.

Do you have discount codes?

Join our newsletter at the bottom of the page for 10% off your first order. Unless stated otherwise, only one discount code can be used per order, codes have no cash value, and they can't be applied to past orders.

Shipping & delivery

How much is shipping?

Standard shipping is included in our prices wherever a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method and any express upgrade before you pay.

How long will my order take?

Orders are prepared in 1–3 business days, then shipped. If checkout shows a delivery estimate for your address, use it as a guide, not a guaranteed date. Because most parcels travel internationally, allow extra time around holidays. See Shipping info.

Will I pay customs or import taxes?

For orders outside the United States, duties and taxes charged by your country are the customer's responsibility unless checkout says they are included. We can't mark orders as gifts or declare a lower value.

Do you ship to my country?

If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, yes. Otherwise email us before ordering.

After you order

Can I change or cancel my order?

Email us as soon as possible, ideally within 24 hours, with your order number and the change (size, color, address or cancellation). If the order hasn't entered fulfillment, we'll update it or refund it in full. Once an order has entered fulfillment it can't be cancelled; you can return it after delivery under our Returns policy.

What does "Unfulfilled" or "Fulfilled" mean?

Unfulfilled means your order is being prepared (1–3 business days). Fulfilled means it has been packed for the carrier and your tracking number has been emailed. The first carrier scan can take 24–48 hours to appear.

How do I track my order?

Use the tracking number in your shipping email on our Track your order page. New tracking numbers can take 24–48 hours to show the first scan.

My tracking hasn't moved or says delivered, but I don't have it

International parcels often pause while clearing customs. If tracking shows no movement for 15 business days, or your order hasn't arrived within 30 days after it shipped, email us and we'll open a carrier investigation. If it shows delivered but you can't find it after 48 hours, email us within 14 days of the delivery scan.

Returns & exchanges

What is your return policy?

You can request a return within 30 days of delivery for unworn, unwashed items with tags attached. Email us first. We'll send a return authorization and the correct return address. Full details are in Returns & exchanges.

My item arrived damaged, defective or wrong

We're sorry! Email us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos of the item, the size tag and the packaging. We'll send a replacement or refund, and usually you won't need to return anything. Reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights.

The size doesn't fit. Can I exchange it?

Yes. Email us with your order number and the size you need. For sizes chosen by the customer, return shipping is paid by the customer. Sometimes we can offer a partial refund or store credit so you can keep the item.

When will I get my refund?

Within 5–10 business days after your return is approved, to your original payment method. Your bank may take another 2–5 business days to show it.

Still have a question?

We're happy to help, whether it's sizing, delivery dates or anything else.

Contact us
faqs.meta_description: Answers about sizing, shipping, tracking, returns and payments for matching family outfits from Dress Like Mommy.

track-your-order.title: Track Your Order
track-your-order.body:
When your order ships, we email you a tracking number. Enter it below to see the latest update from every carrier on your parcel's route.

Results open in a new tab on 17TRACK, an independent tracking service that follows parcels across international and local carriers.

Other ways to check your order

Order status page

Every confirmation and shipping email has a View your order button showing your order status and tracking.

Your account

Signed up with your email? Log in to your account to see all your orders.

Understanding tracking updates

My tracking says "not found" or "no information yet"

Tracking numbers are created before the carrier scans the parcel. It can take 24–48 hours, sometimes a few days on international routes, for the first scan to appear.

Tracking hasn't updated for several days

That's normal while a parcel flies between countries or clears customs. If there's no movement for 15 business days, or your order hasn't arrived within 30 days after it shipped, email us your order number and we'll investigate with the carrier.

The tracking number changed or shows a new carrier

International parcels are handed to a local carrier (for example USPS, Canada Post or Royal Mail) for final delivery. 17TRACK shows both carriers under the same number.

It says delivered, but I don't have it

Check around your property, with neighbors and building reception, and allow 48 hours because carriers sometimes scan early. Then email us within 14 days of the delivery scan and we'll open a claim with the carrier.

I received only part of my order

Orders with several items may ship in more than one parcel. Check your emails for a second tracking number. If you still have a missing item, write to us.

Still can't find your parcel?

Send your order number and we'll check it with the carrier for you.

Email us

size-guide.title: Size Guide
size-guide.body:
Each style comes from its own manufacturer, so sizes are not the same from one product to the next. The product page shows the size chart for that exact item. Use this guide to measure your family and read those charts, and you'll get a great fit for everyone.

The golden rule Always choose sizes from the size chart on the product page, measured in centimeters or inches. Don't go by your usual letter size or your child's age. Many of our styles can run smaller than typical US sizes.

How to measure

Use a soft tape measure over light clothing. Keep the tape snug but not tight, and level all the way around.

MeasurementHow to measure
Bust / chestAround the fullest part of the chest, under the arms.
WaistAround the natural waist, the narrowest part of the torso, usually just above the belly button.
HipsAround the fullest part of the hips and seat, feet together.
LengthFor dresses and tops, from the highest point of the shoulder straight down to where you want the hem.
Height (kids and babies)Standing straight against a wall without shoes, from the floor to the top of the head. For babies, measure lying down.

Reading a product size chart

  • Garment or body measurement? Many of our charts list the garment's flat or finished measurements, not body measurements. For a comfortable fit, choose a garment 2–6 cm (1–2 in) larger than your body for fitted styles, and more for relaxed styles and pajamas.
  • Compare with clothes you love. Lay a similar item from your closet flat, measure it, and compare it with the chart. This is the most reliable method.
  • Allow a small variance. Hand measurement during manufacturing can vary by 1–3 cm (about ½–1 in).
  • Units: 1 inch = 2.54 cm. Check whether the chart is in cm or inches before comparing.

Family matching tips

  • Choose each person's size separately from that product's chart: mom, dad and each child.
  • For kids, go by height first, then chest. Children grow fast: if they are between sizes, choose the larger one.
  • Between sizes for pajamas and loungewear? Size up for comfort, especially in cotton, which can shrink slightly when washed.
  • For fitted dresses and swimwear, choose by your largest measurement (usually bust or hips).
  • Follow the care label: wash cold and line dry to keep the size and colors true.

Not sure? Ask before you order. Send us the product link and your family's measurements, and we'll suggest sizes. It's the fastest way to avoid a return, because size exchanges add shipping time.

Sizing questions sent before ordering are free, and we usually reply within 1 business day. Sizes chosen by the customer that don't fit are handled under our Returns & exchanges policy.

Get a size recommendation

Email the product link plus heights and measurements.

Ask about sizing

By using the site or placing an order, you agree to these Terms together with our Refund Policy, Shipping Policy and Privacy Policy, which form part of these Terms.

1. Changes to these Terms

2. Eligibility and accounts

  • You agree to give accurate, current information, including your shipping address and email, and to keep your account password confidential. You are responsible for activity on your account.

3. How our store works

Dress Like Mommy is an online-only retailer. We have no physical store, showroom or pickup location. Products are produced and shipped to you by our manufacturing and fulfillment partners, many of whom are located outside the United States. That is why delivery times are longer than from local stores, and why orders with several items may arrive in separate parcels.

4. Products, sizing and images

  • We work to describe and show products accurately. Colors can look different on different screens, and prints, trims and shades can vary slightly between production batches.
  • Sizes differ between styles and manufacturers. The size chart on each product page applies to that product. Measurements may vary by about 1–3 cm (½–1 in). Choosing a size is the customer's responsibility; our Size Guide and customer service can help before you order.
  • Some lifestyle and model images are styled, edited or digitally created to show how outfits look together on a family. They illustrate the product's design and print; actual fit follows the product's size chart. They are not a photo of the exact unit you will receive.
  • Follow the care label and any warnings supplied with the product. For children's items, check for loose buttons, trims or accessories before use, keep small parts away from children under 3 (choking hazard), and always supervise young children. Products are intended for normal clothing use only.

5. Prices and errors

  • Prices are shown in the currency selected or shown at checkout. We may change prices at any time; changes do not affect orders already accepted.
  • Despite our care, a product may occasionally be listed with an incorrect price, description or availability. If we discover an obvious error, we may cancel the affected order or item, even after sending an order confirmation, and give you a full refund. We will tell you, and where possible offer the item at the correct price.

The order confirmation email confirms that we received your order; the contract is formed when we accept it by shipping your order and sending a shipping confirmation. We may refuse or cancel any order, and refund you in full, for example because of stock unavailability, suspected fraud, an unverifiable payment or address, a pricing error, or a violation of these Terms.
  • To protect you and us, we may ask you to verify your identity or payment details before shipping, and hold an order until verification is complete.
  • We may limit quantities per person, household or order, and may decline orders that appear to be placed by resellers or through automated means.

7. Payment

We accept the payment methods shown at checkout. Payments are processed by Shopify and its payment partners; we never see or store your full card number. By placing an order, you confirm that you are authorized to use the payment method, and you authorize us to charge the order total, including any applicable taxes, duties collected at checkout and shipping upgrades.

Unless an offer says otherwise: one discount code can be used per order; codes have no cash value, cannot be combined with other offers, and cannot be applied to past orders. We may cancel orders or discounts obtained through misuse, such as creating multiple accounts, reselling codes, or exploiting technical errors. Offers may end or change without notice, but this never affects orders already accepted.

Gift cards, when offered, do not expire and cannot be redeemed for cash, except where the law requires otherwise.

9. Shipping, delivery and risk

  • If we cannot ship your order within the time we stated, we will notify you and you may cancel the unshipped items for a full refund.

If a parcel is undeliverable or returned because of an incorrect address, or because it was refused or not collected, we can reship it at your cost, or refund the items once the parcel returns to us, less the return shipping cost we were charged, which we will tell you, except where the law requires a full refund.
  • Import duties, taxes and customs fees charged by your country are your responsibility unless checkout shows they are included.
  • Ownership and risk of loss pass to you when the carrier delivers the parcel to the shipping address you provided, as shown by carrier tracking. If a parcel is confirmed lost in transit before delivery, we will reship or refund it. Parcels marked delivered but not received must be reported within 14 days of the delivery scan so we can open a carrier claim. Full details are in our Shipping Policy.

10. Returns, refunds and cancellations

Returns, exchanges, refunds and order cancellations are governed by our Refund Policy. In summary: returns must be requested within 30 days of delivery and authorized by us before shipping; items must be unworn, unwashed and with tags; items marked Final Sale, gift cards, and swimwear or intimates with the hygiene liner removed or worn are not returnable, unless they are defective.

If there is a problem with your order, please contact us first at info@dresslikemommy.com; we usually answer within 1 business day and can often resolve it faster than a bank dispute. If a dispute or chargeback is opened, we will provide the payment provider with the relevant order information, including tracking, delivery confirmation and our communications with you. If a dispute is decided in our favor, the original charge stands, and we may decline future orders from accounts that misuse disputes. policy-refund.body:
Last updated: September 27, 2026

We want your whole family to love their matching outfits. This Refund Policy explains how returns, exchanges, refunds and cancellations work for orders from Dress Like Mommy, operated by FKG Trading LLC. A step-by-step version is on our Returns & exchanges page.

Return window

You may request a return or exchange within 30 days of delivery.

How to return

  1. Email info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number, the item(s) and the reason for the return.
  2. We usually reply within 1 business day. If a return is needed, we send a return authorization and the correct return address.
  3. Ship the item(s) within 14 days of our authorization, using a tracked service, and send us the tracking number.
  4. After the return arrives and passes inspection, we email you and issue your refund.

Returns must be authorized before shipping. Our business mailing address is not a returns center. Parcels sent without authorization or to an address other than the one we provide may be lost or delayed and may not be eligible for a refund.

Eligibility

To be eligible, items must be:

  • Unworn, unwashed and in original condition
  • Returned with all original tags attached and in their original packaging
  • Free of stains, pet hair, perfume, deodorant or other signs of use

Non-returnable items

  • Swimwear and intimates once the hygiene liner or seal has been removed or worn
  • Items marked "Final Sale"
  • Gift cards
  • Items requested for return more than 30 days after delivery

These exclusions do not apply to items that are damaged, defective or not as described.

Damaged, defective or incorrect items

Email us within 7 days of delivery with your order number and clear photos of the item, the size or care label, and the packaging. Once the issue is confirmed, we will send a replacement or refund the affected item. In most cases you do not need to return it. Reports made after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights.

Exchanges

To change a size or color, email us with your order number. We usually place the new size as a new order and refund the original item once its return is approved.

Return shipping costs

  • We pay return shipping when we made an error or the item is damaged or defective.
  • For other returns, including change of mind and size exchanges, the customer pays return shipping. Use a tracked service: we cannot refund returns lost in transit without tracking.
  • When return postage would cost more than the item, we may offer a partial refund or store credit and let you keep the item instead. You can always choose a standard return.

Refunds

  • Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. Your bank may take a further 2–5 business days to post it.
  • Standard shipping is included in our product prices, so no separate standard shipping charge applies. Paid express upgrades are refunded when we made an error or where the law requires it.
  • Items returned used, washed, damaged, altered or without tags may be refused and sent back to you at your cost, or receive a partial refund reflecting their reduced value, where the law allows.
  • Refunds for orders paid with a discount reflect the amount actually paid.
  • If you have not received an approved refund within 10 business days, check with your bank or card issuer, then email us and we will investigate.

Cancellations

Email us as soon as possible, ideally within 24 hours of ordering. If the order has not entered fulfillment, we cancel it and refund you in full. Once an order has entered fulfillment it can't be cancelled; you can return it after delivery under this policy.

Refused, undeliverable or uncollected parcels

If a parcel returns to us because the address was incorrect or incomplete, or because it was refused or not collected (including refusal to pay import charges), we refund the items once the parcel is back with us, less the return shipping cost we were charged, which we will tell you, except where the law requires a full refund. Alternatively, we can reship it at your cost.

Payment disputes

Please contact us before opening a dispute or chargeback. We usually answer within 1 business day and can often solve the problem faster. If a dispute is opened, we will share order, tracking and communication records with the payment provider.

Your legal rights

This policy does not limit rights you have under consumer protection laws that cannot be excluded. For example, consumers in the EU and UK may cancel an online purchase within 14 days of receiving it without giving a reason. Tell us within that period, then return the items within 14 days. We refund the price and the cost of standard delivery within 14 days of receiving the items back or proof of return. Direct return costs are paid by the customer.

To use this right you can email us a clear statement, or use this model form: "To FKG Trading LLC (Dress Like Mommy), info@dresslikemommy.com: I hereby give notice that I withdraw from my contract for the sale of the following goods: [items], ordered on [date] / received on [date], order number [number], name, address, date."

Consumers in Australia keep their rights under the Australian Consumer Law, including remedies for items with a major failure.

Contact

Email info@dresslikemommy.com or call (786) 309-6006, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.

policy-shipping.body:
Last updated: September 27, 2026

Dress Like Mommy, operated by FKG Trading LLC, is an online-only store. Our products are produced and shipped to you by trusted manufacturing and fulfillment partners, many of them located outside the United States. Please review the shipping method, price and any delivery estimate shown at checkout before placing your order. A friendly overview is on our Shipping info page.

Where we ship

We ship to the countries and regions shown at checkout. If checkout shows a shipping method for your address, we can deliver there. If your destination is not available, email info@dresslikemommy.com before ordering. P.O. Box, APO/FPO and freight-forwarding addresses depend on carrier options and may not be supported.

Shipping costs

Standard shipping is included in product prices for countries and regions where a standard method is available. Checkout shows the exact method, any express upgrade and its price before payment.

Processing time

Orders are processed within 1–3 business days after payment is confirmed. During holidays, promotions or high-volume periods, processing may take 1–2 more business days. Orders flagged for payment or address verification ship after verification is complete.

Delivery times

  • If checkout shows a delivery estimate for your address, it is an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery date. Customs clearance, carrier volume, weather, holidays and local conditions can add time, especially from November to January.
  • Orders with several items may be shipped in more than one parcel and arrive on different days.
  • If you need an order by a specific date, email us before ordering and we will tell you whether it is realistic.

If we cannot ship your order within the time we stated, we will email you. You may then agree to the new date or cancel the unshipped items for a full refund.

Tracking

We email a tracking number when your order ships. New tracking numbers can take 24–48 hours, sometimes longer on international routes, to show the first scan. Track your parcel on our Track your order page or through the order status link in your email.

Shipping address

You are responsible for entering a complete and correct shipping address. Address changes can only be made before the order ships; email us within 24 hours of ordering. If a parcel is returned because of an incorrect or incomplete address, or because it was refused or not collected, we can reship it at your cost, or refund the items once the parcel is back with us, less the return shipping cost we were charged, which we will tell you, except where the law requires a full refund.

Customs, duties and import taxes

For orders shipped outside the United States, import duties, taxes, brokerage and customs fees charged by the destination country are the customer's responsibility unless checkout shows they are included. We cannot predict these charges, mark orders as gifts, or declare a lower value, because customs declarations must be accurate.

Delayed or lost parcels

If tracking shows no movement for 15 business days, or your order has not arrived within 30 days after it shipped, email us your order number. We will open an investigation with the carrier. If the carrier confirms the parcel is lost, we will reship the items or refund them.

Delivered but not received

If tracking shows the parcel as delivered but you cannot find it, check around your property, with neighbors and building reception, and wait 48 hours, because carriers sometimes scan early. Then report it to us within 14 days of the delivery scan and we will file a claim with the carrier and help you through it. Ownership and risk of loss pass to you when the carrier delivers the parcel to the address you provided. Any replacement or refund for a parcel confirmed as delivered depends on the outcome of the carrier investigation, except where the law requires otherwise.

Damaged parcels

If your parcel or items arrive damaged, take photos of the packaging and the items and email us within 7 days of delivery (reports after 7 days are still reviewed where the law gives you longer rights). See our Refund Policy.

Contact

For shipping questions, email info@dresslikemommy.com with your order number.

policy-privacy.body:
Last updated: September 27, 2026

Dress Like Mommy is operated by FKG Trading LLC, a Florida limited liability company. Your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use and share it, and the choices and rights you have. We've written it in plain language.

1. Who we are

  • Legal entity: FKG Trading LLC
  • Website: dresslikemommy.com
  • Mailing address: 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006

FKG Trading LLC is the controller of the personal information collected through this website.

2. Information we collect

Information you give us

  • Contact details: name, email address, phone number
  • Shipping and billing addresses
  • Payment information: processed securely by Shopify and its payment partners. We never see or store your full card number.
  • Account details: email and password if you create an account
  • Communications: messages you send us by email, contact form or social media, including photos you send for returns or sizing help
  • Order details: products, sizes and quantities purchased

Information collected automatically

  • Device and browser information: browser type, operating system and device type
  • IP address and approximate location (city or region level)
  • Browsing activity: pages and products viewed, time on pages, referring website, and actions such as adding to cart
  • Cookies, pixels and similar technologies (see section 6)

Information from others

  • Shopify: our e-commerce platform
  • Payment processors: payment confirmation and fraud-screening results
  • Advertising and marketing platforms: for example, whether you clicked one of our ads

3. How we use your information

  • Process, fulfill and deliver your orders, including sharing shipping details with our fulfillment partners and carriers
  • Send order confirmations, shipping updates and receipts
  • Answer questions and handle returns, refunds and disputes
  • Detect and prevent fraud, abuse and security incidents
  • Improve our website, products and shopping experience
  • Send marketing emails, only with your consent; you can unsubscribe at any time
  • Show relevant ads and measure how well our advertising works (see sections 5 and 6)
  • Comply with legal, tax and accounting obligations

4. Who we share information with

  • Shopify and payment partners: to run our store and process payments
  • Manufacturing and fulfillment partners: to prepare and ship your order (name, shipping address, phone number and order contents only). Some are located outside your country, including in Asia.
  • Shipping carriers and tracking services: to deliver your parcel and provide tracking
  • Email and customer-service tools: to send order updates and newsletters and answer messages
  • Analytics and advertising partners, such as Google, Microsoft, Pinterest and Meta: to measure site use and ad performance and show relevant ads
  • Authorities and advisers: when required by law, to protect our rights or prevent fraud, or as part of a sale or transfer of our business

We do not sell your personal information for money. However, some U.S. state privacy laws treat sharing browsing data with advertising partners for targeted advertising as a "sale" or "sharing". You can opt out at any time; see section 7.

5. Advertising

We advertise on platforms such as Google, Microsoft Bing, Pinterest and Meta (Facebook and Instagram). These partners may use cookies, pixels or similar technologies to learn which ads led to visits or purchases, and to show you our ads on other websites. Where the law requires consent, we ask for it through our cookie banner before using non-essential advertising cookies.

6. Cookies and tracking

We use cookies to keep your cart working, remember your language and currency, understand traffic, and support advertising. Visitors in regions that require it see a cookie banner to accept or decline non-essential cookies. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings; some site features may then stop working.

7. Your privacy choices and rights

All customers can ask to access, correct or delete their personal information, and can unsubscribe from marketing emails using the link in any email.

  • U.S. state privacy rights (for example, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia and others): you may have the right to know, access, correct and delete your information, and to opt out of the "sale" or "sharing" of personal information and targeted advertising. Use our Do not sell or share my personal information page. Where required, a Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal from your browser is treated as an opt-out request, as described on that page. We will not discriminate against you for using your rights.
  • EEA, UK and Switzerland: you also have the right to data portability, to restrict or object to processing, to withdraw consent at any time, and to complain to your local data protection authority. Our legal bases are performing our contract with you (orders), our legitimate interests (security, fraud prevention and improving our store), your consent (marketing emails and non-essential cookies) and legal obligations.

To make a request, email info@dresslikemommy.com. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request, and we respond within the time required by law (usually within 30 days). An authorized agent may submit a request on your behalf with proof of authorization.

Newsletter discount (notice of financial incentive)

When you join our newsletter, we offer a one-time discount on your first order in exchange for your email address. We use it to send marketing emails. We estimate the value of your email address to our business as roughly equal to the value of the discount offered. Joining is optional, and you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in any email.

8. Children's privacy

We sell children's clothing, but our website is intended for adults and is not directed at children. All purchases must be made by an adult aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 (or under 16 in the EEA). If you believe a child has given us personal information, email us and we will delete it.

9. Data retention

  • Order records: up to 7 years for tax and accounting
  • Account information: while your account is active, or until you ask us to delete it
  • Marketing consent: until you unsubscribe
  • Analytics data: generally no longer than 26 months
  • Support messages: up to 3 years after your request is resolved

10. Security

We use SSL/TLS encryption, PCI-DSS compliant payment processing through Shopify, and access controls to protect your information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security. If a data breach affects you, we will notify you as required by law.

11. International transfers

Your information may be processed in the United States and in other countries where our platform providers and fulfillment partners operate, including in Asia. These countries may have different data protection laws. Transfers needed to process and deliver your order rely on their necessity for performing our contract with you; other transfers rely on the safeguards our service providers offer, where required by law.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy and will change the "Last updated" date. Significant changes will be highlighted on this page.

13. Contact us

  • Email: info@dresslikemommy.com
  • Phone: (786) 309-6006
  • Mail: FKG Trading LLC, 14937 Indigo Lakes Dr, Naples, FL 34119, USA
